mapper.sql: outbox_id AS outboxId, event_id AS eventId, notification_status AS notificationStatus, delivery_channel AS deliveryChannel, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, attempt_count AS attemptCount, next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt, last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, delivered_at AS deliveredAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_critical_notification_outbox (outbox_id, event_id, notification_status, delivery_channel, idempotency_key, attempt_count, next_retry_at, last_error_code, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{outboxId}, #{eventId}, #{notificationStatus}, #{deliveryChannel}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{attemptCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{lastErrorCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE report_critical_notification_outbox SET notification_status = #{notificationStatus}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, delivered_at = #{deliveredAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE outbox_id = #{outboxId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM report_critical_notification_outbox WHERE notification_status IN ('PENDING','RETRYING','FAILED') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY created_at ASC, outbox_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
